description:
Create a new agent. An agent owns phone numbers and handles calls/SMS.

A newly created agent has no phone number until one is attached.
Set voice_mode to 'hosted' with a system_prompt for autonomous AI voice calls, or 'webhook' (default) to forward call transcripts to your webhook URL.
Returns the created agent, including its new ID and full configuration.

ambient_sound.description: Optional background ambience for call audio. Not a substitute for AI self-identification; this connector adds disclosure only to outbound calls placed through its call tools.

begin_message.description: What the AI says first when a call connects (hosted mode only). If omitted, the AI opens on its own based on the system prompt.

denoising_mode.description: Audio denoising. The aggressive mode helps callers in cars/cafes (small surcharge).

description.description: A short note describing what this agent is for (e.g. 'handles billing questions'). For your reference; it does not change how the agent behaves.

enable_backchannel.description: Whether the agent interjects 'uh-huh'/'mhmm' while the caller speaks. Default true.

enable_messaging.description: Whether a hosted agent can send and read texts during a call. Default true.

interruption_sensitivity.description: How readily the agent lets a caller interrupt it — lower values make it harder to cut off, higher values stop it at the first sound.

language.description: BCP-47 locale for speech recognition and synthesis, e.g. 'en-US', 'es-ES', 'ja-JP'.

max_silence_ms.description: How long the agent waits through continuous caller silence before ending the call. Omit to use the server default (about 10 minutes).

model_tier.description: Model quality/speed tier for hosted-mode agents. 'turbo' = fastest/cheapest, 'balanced' (default) = general use, 'max' = highest quality, 'realtime' = speech-to-speech, lowest latency.

name.description: A label for the agent, shown in listings and account views (e.g. 'Customer Support' or 'Sales Bot').

stt_mode.description: Speech-to-text mode: 'fast' (default) lowest latency, 'accurate' for exact names/numbers (~200ms slower).

system_prompt.description: Required when voice_mode is 'hosted'. The AI's personality and instructions for voice calls.

transfer_number.description: Phone number to transfer calls to (E.164 format). Enables call transfer during conversations.

voice.description: A voice ID from list_voices. Defaults to 'Skylar - Friendly Guide' if omitted.

voice_mode.description: How calls are handled: forward transcripts to your webhook (the default), or use the built-in hosted AI driven by system_prompt.

voice_speed.description: How fast the agent speaks, as a multiplier of normal pace (1 is normal, below 1 is slower, above 1 is faster). If omitted, the agent uses its default speed.

voicemail_message.description: Voicemail greeting text. When set, unanswered calls hear this message and can leave a voicemail.
